description: Build a first-party Progressive CMS extension: manifest with declarative config_schema (settings, secrets, network), typed operations or provider registrations, migrations, Admin-rendered settings and release packaging — battle-tested by the shipped media providers and prompt enhancer.
entry_workflow: read Extensions spec sections referenced by the shipped extensions (extensions/ — the living examples)
choose the contribution kind: typed operations, media stock/generation provider, events, validators, blocks/field types
write manifest.json: id, version, permissions (registry-checked), registrations, config_schema (settings + secret-ref slots + network block where egress is needed)
implement the module: named handler exports; providers receive resolved config; operations receive {input, actor, requestId, extension:{id, config(resolved)}}
outbound egress only through createExtensionFetchClientFromConfig (SOCKS5-capable, network from config — never hardcoded) with host allowlisting
typed errors only (ProviderError taxonomy / domain codes with stable status mapping)
migrations directory for schema changes (additive, forward-only)
unit tests for pure logic + integration tests for handlers (see tests/extensions/)
register in extensions/catalog.ts (the pin test fails otherwise)
npm run check; build a release artifact and verify the extension shipped inside it
install/enable on a test instance, exercise settings through the Admin settings dialog (GET/PUT /extensions/{id}/config, write-only secrets)
